Library.q: How many hearts does an octopus have?
Library.text: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood. Two hearts pump blood to the gills, and one pumps it to the rest of the body.

Library.q: About how long does sunlight take to reach Earth?
Library.text: Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth, traveling roughly 150 million kilometers.

Library.q: Which of these is botanically a berry?
Library.text: Bananas are botanically berries, while strawberries are not, because strawberries form from a flower with many ovaries.

Library.q: About how many neurons does a human brain have?
Library.text: The human brain has about 86 billion neurons. Connections between them matter more for intelligence than the raw number.
Water expands when it freezes, which is why ice floats. This keeps lakes from freezing solid from the bottom up.

Library.q: What do bees use to show where flowers are?
Library.text: Honeybees communicate the location of flowers with a 'waggle dance'. The angle of the dance shows the direction.

Library.q: Was Einstein's brain bigger than average?
Library.text: Einstein's brain was slightly smaller than average. Scientists think how neurons are connected matters more than size.
Sound travels about 343 meters per second in air, but more than four times faster in water.
